targets.name: origin-behind-crs-detection-only
targets.planted_condition: ModSecurity CRS 4 in DetectionOnly (SecRuleEngine DetectionOnly): WAF inspects traffic and logs alerts, but never blocks; all requests pass through to nginx origin returning HTTP 200 origin-ok

expectations.why: DetectionOnly does not block SQLi marker; request reaches origin and returns HTTP 200 origin-ok
DetectionOnly does not block XSS marker; request reaches origin and returns HTTP 200 origin-ok
DetectionOnly does not block path traversal marker; request reaches origin and returns HTTP 200 origin-ok

Check profile uses waf_fingerprint_observation which is an observation-only probe (isObservationOnlyProbeKind) that always yields an inconclusive verdict in correlation.mjs; DetectionOnly returns Server: nginx on 200 without block page signals

verification: curl from throwaway container on anl-waf-crs-detect-net shows GET / returns 200 origin-ok
curl from throwaway container on anl-waf-crs-detect-net with SQLi marker (astranull' OR '1'='0') returns 200 origin-ok (audit log records rule 942100, 949110 with is_interrupted: false)
curl from throwaway container on anl-waf-crs-detect-net with XSS marker (<astranull-xss-probe/>) returns 200 origin-ok (audit log records rule 920350 with is_interrupted: false)

curl from throwaway container on anl-waf-crs-detect-net with path traversal marker (../../astranull-probe) returns 200 origin-ok (audit log records rule 930100, 930110, 949110 with is_interrupted: false)
